estimates.difficulty: 4/10 (ESTIMATE - PowerPyx rating as reported by launch-day guides)
estimates.playthroughs: 1 (no difficulty settings, no mission replay; free roam continues after the story)
estimates.missable: 1 possible: Positive Mental Attitude (UNCONFIRMED whether the Chapter 1 spot is required)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are in your collection — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the list below in stage order and this one closes the book.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end. It is the first mission of the game, so this one is unmissable — finish the intro and it pops.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: See Chapter 1 through to its final mission. Chapter trophies are story beats, so keep playing and this one arrives on its own.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 in full. Nothing optional is needed — the trophy is tied to the chapter's last mission.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Like the other chapter trophies it cannot be missed; the chapter's closing mission triggers it.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Keep following the story and it pops at the chapter's end.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the game. This gold trophy is the story's closing beat — the credits roll and it unlocks.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Mission trophies unlock at the mission's end, so play it through.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. It is a named story mission — finish it and the trophy is yours.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. A story mission trophy; no extra objective is attached.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at its end.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. A named story mission — play it through to the end.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Story mission trophy, unmissable.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the full list sits in-game under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. GTABase's launch-day breakdown of what it asks for: every robbery including 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations, the underwater finds, 42 Shooting Range gold medals, every drone race, Bret's 15 Target Decks, plus 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. This is the long gold of the list — most of the post-story grind points at it.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across your playthrough. Stunts count whenever you catch air, land a jump or thread a near miss — they pile up naturally while you drive Leonida, and the running total sits in Progress > Stats. Push the count deliberately on the long jumps outside the city if you are short after the story.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — all nine of them. Sample each one and the trophy pops. Leave it for clean-up if a type has not shown up during the story.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges are found around the state; each challenge grades you, so replay any challenge that lands below gold until it does. No range is missable — all of them stay open after the story.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's line first — a clean run beats a fast one — then take the win at each spot. Locations stay available in free roam.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts; the key word is different, so spread your wins across the map instead of repeating one favourite. Races stay open after the story.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing opens early through Cal — answer his messages when they arrive in Chapter 1, head to the water with him and out-fish him. The challenge can be retried if you lose the first round.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Arcades are scattered through Vice City and the wider state — sit down at any cabinet, play it to its end and the trophy pops.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's line. Side-character lines open as the story moves; keep taking Andy's missions when they appear and the finale closes his strand.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's line. Work through Kenton's missions as they are offered and finish the last one.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's line. Billy's missions arrive over the story — take them when offered and close the line with its final mission.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions are marked on the map when you pass their spots; each strand is a short chain, and eight finished strands earn the silver. These strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so they are clean-up work — sweep the map for the stranger markers after the story.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's line. Take Randy's missions as they come and finish the last one.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's line. Work Tyrone's missions through to the finale.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The one spot that matters most is in Chapter 1: the morning after the mission Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen out to the balcony and take the meditation she offers — that moment is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and PowerPyx flagged it as the list's one possible missable. Whether the trophy truly requires that spot was UNCONFIRMED at launch, but every reported platinum run did it and it takes two minutes. The other 17 spots stay available in free roam, so sweep them after the story. (The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18, so this trophy cannot block A Long Road either way.)
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)
PowerPyx possible-missable flag via launch-day guides

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunts start when his line opens — follow his missions until the unique animal is marked, track it down and take the shot.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are tucked around Leonida — in shops, houses and odd corners — and a set completes when every card in it is found. Collect them in free roam; no set is missable.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are the wall-art tags around the state — scan each one as you pass it, and the count builds. Turn on collectible notifications in Settings so you never walk past one unknowingly.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small tasks the game tracks in the background — driving, shooting, exploring — and they stack up over a full playthrough. Check Progress > Stats to see which are close, then finish the nearest ones.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then get clear. From Chapter 2 both characters can travel together, so stir up a 4-star response with your partner beside you, break line of sight and stay out of the search until the stars clear.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, without ever losing your wanted level between them. Bring your partner, hit one shop, then drive straight to the next while the heat is still on — the chain breaks if the wanted level drops. Keep the route short and the getaways clean.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts as discovered — scan the traffic around you and hop into anything you have not driven yet. The count climbs fastest by driving through varied districts instead of sticking to one car.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a crowd, trigger Combat Focus when five enemies are in view, and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy firefight — thin encounters will not give you five targets.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA — the airport. Steal a plane and take off without following the airport's script: grab one from the tarmac and lift off. The trophy is about leaving on your own terms, so do not wait for a mission to hand you the runway.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not instructions — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' No source had confirmed the exact trigger at launch, so this one is UNCONFIRMED: the working guess from launch-day guides is that it involves the Rhino tank at Mile Zero, but do not chase it until a guide confirms the method. Try the tank encounter in free roam and watch for the pop.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet and keep the staff and cameras from ever spotting you — the moment anyone raises the alarm the attempt is over, so slip out and try again.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults are the big jobs — plan each one, crack the vault, then lose the heat before the trophy counts. All five stay available in free roam, so work them after the story when you are geared up.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes through the city — ram or block one, crack it open, take the cash and break away before the response arrives.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map clears its fog as you travel — drive, fly and sail into every corner until all 52 areas are visited. Save this for clean-up and sweep the map systematically, island by island.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs operations around the state — hit one per gang and the trophy pops. Operations stay open after the story.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take it in by the water. The trophy is a quiet moment — no mission needed, just the right spot and a drink.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side — the trophy wants the smash, not a careful exit. UNCONFIRMED at launch exactly which showroom and exit the game counts, so try the main showroom in free roam.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go bowling at the alley — play a frame through to its end. A full game at the lanes is what the trophy asks for.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description gives no method, and no source had confirmed the trigger at launch — UNCONFIRMED. The name points at doing something notable together with your partner, so keep an eye on launch-week guides and try the big partner moments in free roam.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made — for better or worse. A hidden counter tracks the choices you make across the game, and the trophy pops when it reaches 500. Keep playing and choosing; it fills up over a full playthrough without any single big decision.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The trigger was UNCONFIRMED at launch — no source had pinned down what has to fail once and succeed the second time. It is one of the joke trophies; watch launch-week guides rather than guessing at it.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The trophy's method was UNCONFIRMED at launch — it points at witnessing something strange somewhere in Leonida, but no source had confirmed the place or the event. Keep it for clean-up and check updated guides.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Strike someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — line up a slow pass, swing as you roll past, and the trophy should pop on the hit.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — hand them to your contacts to wash them, and the laundered total climbs toward $250,000. Keep robbing and laundering through the post-story grind.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every dollar you spend in any shop counts — clothes, weapons, food, cars — so this one fills itself up if you shop as you play. Top it up in clean-up by buying the expensive items you skipped.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought around the state — each one stores your vehicles, and owning all eight pops the trophy. Save up through the story and buy them in free roam.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone, register the vehicles you drive — ten different registrations earns the trophy. Any vehicle you own or find can be registered.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (launch day, 19 Nov 2026)
